metadata.case_name: KWOK MEI TAI v. TANG YU HAND AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Domestic duties and part-time work taking shells off shellfish (earned $5 to $6 a day); living and working on a boat (fishing junk) permanently moored at Castle Peak
plaintiff.occupation_after: Now able to resume part-time shellfish work on a slightly reduced scale

injuries.description: a fracture of the right tibia; being the bone of the lower right leg. This fracture involved the knee joint.
source: a fracture of the right tibia; being the bone of the lower right leg. This fracture involved the knee joint.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of upper end of tibia, unspecified

source: abrasions to the left hand and right forehead. The abrasions have healed and left no scars.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of other parts of wrist or hand

source: abrasions to the left hand and right forehead. The abrasions have healed and left no scars.
injuries.icd_description: Abrasion of other or unspecified sites of head

manifestations.description: pain felt when she recovered consciousness after the accident
walking with a marked lurching limp; still walking with a limp (less noticeable)
considerable muscular wasting (earlier), measurements of calf and thigh of right leg later same as left (earlier wasting disappeared)
laxity of the lateral ligaments of the knee (reduced to one-half of an inch), instability of the knee joint
marked abnormality of the joint bearing surfaces of the knee; bony abnormality of the knee joint
bound to develop osteo - arthritis (probable future osteo-arthritis)

treatments_received: Long leg plaster cast applied to the thigh to include the whole of the right leg

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities (award $15,000)
Loss of future earning capacity: reduced by about $15 per month; annual loss fixed at $200; total sum for loss of future earnings $2,400

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Inconvenience in discharge of normal domestic duties due to permanent limp, aggravated by living on a junk and having to reach shore by sampan or plank
